judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner is an incorporated body engaged in quartz mining; agreed to enter into an agreement with the Respondent to obtain a long-term lease in respect of the land in suit from and out of a larger estate vested in the Respondent. The Petitioner had been in possession of the land in suit since 2003 and has complied with all requests of the Respondent including paying part of the rental and obtaining a private surveyor to identify and demarcate the land in suit. Additionally, in 2021, the Petitioner obtained permission from the Respondent to fix a weighbridge which was allowed. However, the Respondent delayed formalising the lease. Held – Petitioner had legitimate expectation; Respondent is bound by its conduct since it is estopped from going back on its original agreement; writ issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
